title: The Ghost Domain
brief: A SERPENT informant received an email from 'collector@hacktoria.com' but suspects it's not really us. Check the public WHOIS record of hacktoria.com. Reply with the registration year.
hint: Any public WHOIS service will show the creation date.

title: The Impostor Handler
brief: Someone is impersonating Klumgongyn, our alien liaison. The real Klumgongyn always names his home planet when he signs a message. Which planet is that?

title: Rack Radiation
brief: The server rack in the lab is blinking a warning pattern. The failing unit's serial starts with the same letters as our agency acronym. What are the first three letters of 'Special Espionage Reconnaissance Protection Enforcement Neutralization Taskforce'?
hint: Take the first letter of each main word.

title: Ghost Ship of the Gulf
brief: A cargo vessel went dark in the Baltic after leaving a Finnish port. Using public AIS history sites, determine how many digits a full IMO number has.

title: Forensic First Contact
brief: A photograph recovered from a suspect's post shows the sun setting over open water. If genuine, the camera was facing roughly which cardinal direction in the evening? (north/south/east/west)
hint: The sun sets in the west everywhere on Earth.

title: The Serpent's Cipher
brief: The door keypad at HQ blinks at you. The passcode is the number of letters in the name of SERPENT's alien liaison. How many letters are in 'Klumgongyn'?
